after: ## Approaches to researching behaviour (20 hours SL / 60 hours HL)
alt: Two stacked bars. SL, 150 hours: core 90, approaches to researching behaviour 20, one option 20, internal assessment 20. HL, 240 hours: core 120, research 60, two options 40, internal assessment 20.
caption: The biggest HL jump is in research methodology, examined in Paper 3.

alt: Memory in the centre branches to the three core approaches: biological, through brain structures; cognitive, through information-processing models; and sociocultural, through the influence of schema and culture on recall.
caption: Practise moving between all three approaches on the same topic.

alt: The three core approaches are examined in Paper 1, with short-answer questions and one essay. The option or options go to Paper 2, where HL students write one essay on each of their two options. Research methodology goes to Paper 3, for HL only. The experimental study is the internal assessment, externally moderated.
caption: Paper 2 is option-specific, so know exactly which options you studied.
